content:
I will be interviewing Chuck Thompson about his new book, “Sasquatch Country: Death, Myth, and Truth in the New American Wilderness,” about the two alleged Sasquatch hunters who died over Christmas 2024 while hiking in the Gifford Pinchot.

Chuck writes “The book is about the backlash to Sasquatch believers that blew up internationally after two hikers in Washington State were found frozen to death over Christmas 2024 and erroneously identified as “Sasquatch hunters” after their bodies were recovered following a thee-day search and rescue. You might recall some of the headlines. My investigation of the story turned tricky, however, when I discovered that one of the men had indeed previously claimed to have had a close encounter with a Sasquatch in the area the men had been hiking.”

The book dives into the mystery surrounding the men and their fatal hike, the history of Sasquatch culture in the Gifford Pinchot National Forest (with coverage of encounters) and the unfair derision heaped upon the men (and their grieving families) after the Sasquatch story was reported.
